<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the unknown molecule. The only way to infer that without a structural description is to obtain its 13C NMR spectrum and count the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm). This will give the number of distinct aromatic carbon environments, which for a simple aromatic ring equals the number of aromatic carbons if the ring is symmetric. We'll request the 13C NMR spectrum and then count the aromatic peaks.</thought>
